Terrabank Selects TerraPay to Power Cross-Border Pay-to-Account and Digital Wallet Transactions via the Mozrt SmartRails™ Platform
summary:
Terrabank, a Miami-based community bank and affiliate of Grupo Promerica, today announced a strategic partnership with TerraPay, a global money movement company, and Mozrt, a payments technology platform, to modernize and streamline cross-border payments. The collaboration enables Terrabank to offer pay-to-account and digital wallets through the Mozrt SmartRails™ payment platform. Clients will experience enhanced international transfer capabilities for consumer remittances and business payments, helping them move money across borders with greater speed, security and confidence. 
By connecting TerraPay’s expansive global clearing network with the advanced, intelligent routing power of Mozrt SmartRails™, the partnership delivers a completely automated, frictionless cross-border payment experience while significantly increasing transaction speed.
The partnership is expected to deliver several key enhancements for financial institutions and their end-users:
Compliance First: Integrated fraud prevention, OFAC, and AML checks for secure payments.
Expanded Reach: Direct access to global digital wallets and bank accounts.
Enhanced Speed: Accelerated cross-border transactions for faster settlement times.
Cost Efficiency: Lower, highly transparent fees compared to traditional international wires.
"The value of connecting to a money movement network such as TerraPay is a game-changer for institutions of all sizes," said Jeff Althaus, President and CEO of Mozrt. "Working together with TerraPay and Terrabank is a perfect example of how modern global payments are supposed to work."
For Terrabank, the partnership represents another step in expanding the international banking capabilities available to its clients while maintaining the personalized service and relationship-based approach that have defined the bank for more than four decades.
"Our ultimate goal is to make payments as seamless and intuitive as possible for our clients,” said Antonio Uribe, president and CEO of Terrabank. "Integrating TerraPay's global network of accounts and digital wallets into our existing Mozrt SmartRails™ platform strengthens our international payment capabilities and expands the options available to them.”
The partnership highlights the sheer scale and speed of TerraPay's infrastructure, which, when paired with Mozrt’s smart routing, unlocks massive global reach for Terrabank's retail, business, correspondent banking, and fintech clients.
"Terrabank's ambition for its customers is exactly why we built TerraPay's network the way we did," added Ralph Koker, Head of Europe and Americas, TerraPay. "This partnership gives Terrabank instant access to 156+ countries and payment corridors, turning what used to be days of correspondent banking negotiations into a single integration. That's the kind of reach we strive to deliver to banks, and we are excited about this partnership as it is close to our vision.”

The collaboration aims to deliver faster, more secure, and cost-efficient international money transfers for both consumers and businesses, supported by integrated compliance and fraud prevention measures.

title: Trust Becomes the New Cyber Battleground in 2027
summary:
Experian® today released its 2027 Data Breach Industry Forecast: Consumers at Risk, offering a look at the evolving cybersecurity landscape and the growing risks facing consumers and organizations in the years ahead. Now in its 14th year, the annual report explores how artificial intelligence (AI), identity fraud, data breaches and digital deception are converging to create what may become one of the biggest cybersecurity challenges of next year and beyond: a crisis of trust.
As cybercriminals gain access to decades of stolen personal data and increasingly powerful AI tools, businesses may find it harder than ever to verify identities online to combat fraud. At the same time, consumers may face increasing difficulty distinguishing legitimate communications from fraudulent ones and preventing identity doppelgängers. The report examines how these trends could transform the relationship between businesses, consumers and digital trust.
"Organizations have spent years focusing on preventing breaches and securing data. But with decades of exposed data already circulating the focus also needs to be on verification practices, combatting fraud and helping consumers determine what and who they can trust," said Michael Bruemmer, Vice President of Global Data Breach Resolution at Experian. "Cybersecurity is entering a new era where proving authenticity is just as important as protecting data and Experian can help with leading verification and fraud prevention services as well as providing post-incident response support. Businesses that prepare now will be in a stronger position to navigate the evolving threat landscape and maintain customer confidence."
Emerging Trends That Could Shape 2027
The forecast outlines four predictions that examine potential changes and risks on the horizon, including:
Proof of Being Human Becomes the Hottest New Market: The rise of technologies and services designed to help organizations and consumers verify authenticity in an AI-driven world.
The Rise of the Digital Doppelgänger: The evolution of identity theft as cybercriminals build increasingly sophisticated and convincing profiles of individuals.
Consumers Fighting Fire with Fire: New ways consumers may attempt to protect themselves from identity theft as the number of data breaches continues to climb.
Breach Notifications Need a Reset: How growing skepticism toward digital communications could influence regulatory mandates and future data breach notification practices.
Experian Data Breach Resolution helps organizations respond quickly and confidently to data breaches with over 24 years of crisis-management experience. The company's services include breach preparedness, consumer notification, contact center support, identity protection services and global response capabilities designed to help organizations protect customer trust and reduce reputational risk.

content: Experian released its 2027 Data Breach Industry Forecast, warning that artificial intelligence and identity fraud are creating a major crisis of digital trust. Experian emphasizes that proving authenticity is becoming as crucial as protecting data, outlining key emerging trends like human verification markets and digital doppelgängers.

Mastercard Advances Commercial Payments with AI-Powered B2B Analytics Solution
summary:
We hear it time and time again. One of the biggest pain points for banks and corporates is supplier payments. That’s why we’re introducing Mastercard Advanced B2B Analytics, a card acceptance analytics platform that provides dynamic, accurate and actionable supplier payment insights in minutes. Issuers can now drive commercial card spend at scale, capture additional revenues and help corporate clients identify opportunities to optimize working capital.
"Businesses today are sitting on vast amounts of payment data, but too often it remains fragmented and underutilized," said Marc Pettican, global head of Corporate Solutions at Mastercard. “With Advanced B2B Analytics, we're combining powerful insights with our deep commercial payments expertise to help issuers identify where card acceptance can deliver the greatest value, engage suppliers more effectively and drive measurable growth.”
Issuers and corporate buyers today often lack an insight-driven way to identify and prioritize supplier acceptance opportunities. Fragmented data and manual processes can slow conversion and prolong reliance on less efficient payment methods, despite growing demand for smarter payment experiences, with nearly half of suppliers expecting buyers to request card payments more frequently in the years ahead.
Actionable insights, measurable growth 
Advanced B2B Analytics helps financial institutions and their corporate customers identify supplier payment opportunities with greater precision by transforming accounts payable insights into actionable insights. Combined with consulting expertise from the Mastercard Advisors & Transformation team, the platform helps streamline procurement processes, reduce costs and accelerate commercial card acceptance at scale.
Through Mastercard’s latest commercial payments innovation, issuers can enable their corporate customers to:
Identify suppliers most likely to accept card payments using dynamic acceptance propensity scoringenabled by an underlying AI-powered infrastructure
Gain actionable insights from accounts payable intel through interactive dashboards and analytics 
Optimize working capital with greater visibility into payment flows
Scale commercial card adoption and improve supplier engagement through more targeted outreach
Access Mastercard expertise and recommendations to support supplier prioritization and growth strategies
For financial institutions, Advanced B2B Analytics offers a differentiated way to deepen client relationships and accelerate commercial card growth, helping capture a share of the approximately $80 trillion addressable B2B payments opportunity. 
Absa Group and Emirates NBD are among the first financial institutions to offer Advanced B2B Analytics to their corporate clients, leveraging data-driven insights to identify supplier acceptance opportunities and unlock greater value from their payables. This capability will help clients optimize working capital, accelerate virtual card adoption and drive efficiencies across commercial payments. 
 “We understand that businesses need meaningful insights to make important decisions every day. “Our partnership with Mastercard gives clients a smarter way to understand their payment ecosystems, unlock value across their supplier networks and improve cash flow management,” said Pascalle Albrecht, Executive for Commercial Issuing, Product at Absa Business Banking. “Through this new capability, we are helping businesses operate more efficiently and succeed in a rapidly changing environment.”
Mastercard’s role in an AI-powered future 
By connecting payment, acceptance and performance insights, Mastercard is building toward a future where intelligence is embedded across the commercial payments lifecycle.
Mastercard Advanced B2B Analytics is the first foundational B2B capability to support that vision. As fast as AI is evolving, Mastercard will further extend intelligence and insights to the supplier and acquirer side of the ecosystem, progressively scaling across the commercial payments journey to create more connected, proactive and personalized experiences.
This reflects Mastercard's broader strategy of embedding data, analytics and AI into the infrastructure that powers payments, helping customers make smarter decisions and optimize outcomes for every payment interaction. From Advanced B2B Analytics to innovations like Mastercard Virtual C-Suite, Mastercard is translating its data & AI vision into practical, measurable value for businesses of all sizes.

UPTECH to Exhibit End-to-End Brokerage Solutions at iFX EXPO Asia 2026, Booth #17
summary:
UPTECH, an institutional financial technology provider, announced today its official participation as an exhibitor at iFX EXPO Asia 2026. The event is scheduled from October 7 to 9, 2026, at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre (HKCEC). Located at Booth #17, UPTECH will present its "End-to-End Brokerage Solutions," demonstrating how its comprehensive technology stack fulfills all technical requirements for start-up and expanding financial brokerages with a single partner.
In the past, setting up or upgrading a brokerage involved integrating disparate technologies from various vendors, including trading engines, liquidity bridges, CRM systems, and fiat or crypto payment gateways. UPTECH eliminates this operational friction by offering a complete, institutional-grade ecosystem.
The UPTECH Ecosystem Architecture
UPTECH provides financial institutions with a fully integrated suite of tools. This allows brokers to adopt the complete stack or select specific modules:
Web Trading & Client Portal (UPBASE): An intuitive, web-based portal that serves as the primary visual hub, connecting traders directly to onboarding, KYC verification, account management, and multi-asset trading. Instantly toggle between MT4, MT5, and CTOTrader engines directly within the same trading view.
Trading System (CTOTrader & Trading Engine Integration): High-performance execution and order-routing engine designed for multi-asset market operations.
Risk Management System (UPSHIELD): Advanced analytics engines offering real-time exposure monitoring, automated margin alerts, and risk-hedging capabilities.
Customer Success & Ticket System (UPAGENT): Dedicated CRM and ticketing infrastructure tailored to financial brokerage workflows and client retention.
Decentralized Payment Protocol (UPTOPAY): A self-custodial Web3 payment gateway supporting multi-chain deposits (L1/L2), automated CREATE2 address rotation, and active AML compliance screening.
Streamlining Launch Timelines for Global Brokerages
For emerging financial institutions, UPTECH’s end-to-end delivery removes the complexity of managing multiple software suppliers, reducing deployment timelines from months to weeks. Brokerage operators gain immediate access to trading execution, risk management, liquidity, client management, and Web3 payment processing through one unified partner.
For established brokers, UPTECH’s modular architecture offers flexible deployment. Operators can integrate individual components or utilize UPBASE as a front-end portal to upgrade existing infrastructure without disrupting live trading operations.
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
Q: What does UPTECH’s "End-To-End Brokerage Solution" entail?
A: UPTECH provides the complete technology suite required to run a brokerage. This encompasses a trading engine (CTOTrader), risk management system (UPSHIELD), customer support ticket system(UPAGENT), institutional liquidity bridge (UPPRIME), Web3 payment gateway (UPTOPAY), and web trading client portal(UPBASE). This eliminates the need for third-party software integration.
Q: What is UPBASE, and how does it fit into the UPTECH ecosystem?
A: UPBASE is a Web Trading Client Portal. While it is one product within the broader ecosystem, it acts as the primary visual interface, seamlessly connecting brokers and traders to UPTECH’s underlying risk, trading, CRM, and payment engines.
Q: Can existing brokerages adopt specific UPTECH modules without replacing their current setup?
A: Yes. All UPTECH solutions, including UPBASE, CTOTrader, UPSHIELD, UPAGENT, and UPTOPAY, are modular and can be integrated independently into existing brokerage environments.
Connect with UPTECH at iFX EXPO Asia 2026
The UPTECH executive and technical teams will be on-site throughout the event to demonstrate the unified ecosystem and discuss custom brokerage deployments.
